subject: [AMBER] RNA chiOL3 and LJbb with epsilon-zeta correction

messages.author: Mandar Kulkarni
messages.body:
Hello Everyone,
I am trying RNA LJbb parameters in AMBERTOOL21 for RNA tetraloop. Recent
studies have also applied correction for epsilon/zeta torsion for LJbb
modification.
How can I apply epsilon/zeta modification with RNA.LJbb in AMBERTOOLS 21?
Thanks,
Mandar Kulkarni
